pages.text: $(italic)$(#6b5a45)Buildings are picked in $(l:wandscape:management/panel_build_guide)Build Mode$(/l)$(italic)$(#6b5a45), and each one lists the town level it needs.$()$(br2)Dealing with a building means having the management panel open first: press V, aim at the building until a white box appears around i

t, and right-click to open its screen. With the panel closed, right-clicking a building does nothing at all and it just looks like an$(br2)ordinary block. A building that belongs to someone else's town turns you away.

$(bold)Town Hall, Warehouse, Workstation$() — the ground floor: nothing goes up without a Town Hall, the Warehouse holds what the who$(br)le town shares, and the Workstation swaps elements and items both ways.
pages.title: What to build first

pages.text: $(bold)Crafting Station, Magic Workshop, Tavern, Mage Hut$() — the line to lay down for fighting strength: gear, scrolls, mages to hi$(br)re and somewhere to train them.$(li)$(bold)Altar$() — how a fallen mage comes back.
$(bold)Shop, Services, Relax, ATM, Decorations$() — the tourist track's earning set: shops take elements in, services and relax build
ings keep tourists around, ATMs keep them spending, and decorations boost those buildings.$(li)$(bold)Element Node$() — the proper source of elements.
